text:
Maria: quick sync — we're finalizing the newsletter drip that ties to next week's benchmark webinar. goal: drive live regs + post-event drift to the benchmark post. share timing options?
Sam: for APAC can we stagger sends instead of one global blast? avoids midnight opens.
Maria: yes. propose local 9am send (APAC), 10am EMEA, 9am PT for NA. keeps subject relevance.
Elaine: on subject lines — two directions: privacy-focused benchmark hook vs velocity/cost-savings hook. examples: "Redwood benchmark: 3× throughput, cost down 40%" or "How teams cut inference cost while staying fast". thoughts?
Jin: both sound good. recommend we map hooks to segments: infra/platform leads get cost/throughput, product folks get "how this changes UX".
Sam: segment definitions? I can run lists but need clear filters.
Jin: segment query (for DF):
```
SELECT email FROM users WHERE role IN ('infra','platform') AND last_engagement > now() - interval '180 days' AND unsubscribed = false
```
Sam: perfect. I'll queue that. also flag: exclude trial_opt_out and partner_contacts.
Maria: CTA question — should the newsletter link straight to the webinar reg page or to a blog + reg CTA? my instinct: direct reg for first email, blog in follow-up. A/B test CTA destination.
Elaine: agree. first touch = low friction (direct reg). follow-up drip can surface the benchmark blog and excerpt.
PreviewBot: preview link: https://preview.redwood.ai/newsletter/1759876543 (staging). screen looks good on mobile but check subject snippet.
Jin: analytics tags: add utm_campaign=benchmark_launch, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment_variant}. also add event=nl_open and nl_click for registration funnel.
Sam: timeline: Elaine drafts copy by Tue EOD, Maria to review Wed morning, QA Thu, send Fri (NA/EMEA), APAC Monday local. ok?
Maria: :thumbsup: locking that. Sam — please attach segment counts after your run so we can sanity-check capacity for dedicated cohort.
Sam: will do. expecting ~12k infra+platform, ~18k product across regions. will confirm.
Elaine: i'll keep subject lines short (<65 chars), include 1 emoji in variants, and prepare 2 button CTAs (Register | Save the Date).
Maria: nice — also ensure suppression list includes previous webinar no-shows if they opted out.
Jin: added note: for Dedicated customers route, we should append "Dedicated customers: get priority access" snippet so AE outreach can follow.
Maria: great callout. ok team — I'll consolidate notes into the newsletter brief and post in this thread. thanks everyone.
Sam: thanks!
Elaine: on it.
PreviewBot: deploy job queued for staging preview (job 4821).
